name: The Great Taipei Gas Corporation
summary: The Great Taipei Gas Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, supplies natural gas in Taiwan. The company provides meter installation, calculation, maintenance and repair services. It also manufactures, installs, markets, and supplies gas and related equipment; and sells measuring instruments and meters, such as gauges and meters.
